concepts.prompt: Create a polished landscape 1536x1024 website concept for Perry, an AI assistant for Mac. Reference image establishes identity: ivory paper desktop, ink black, coral cursor, tiny round-head two-oval-eye stick mascot without mouth. Entire website feels like one continuous macOS desktop with menu bar and Dock. Precise native interface typography, daring scale and composed negative space, soulful understated humor. No paper peel, notebook, torn paper, feature cards, gradient blobs, generic SaaS layout, laptop hardware, random decorative stickers. This is a screenshot of a designed website, not presentation mockup. Design the FINAL FOOTER as an enormous close-up of the macOS Dock, spanning screen edge to edge across lower middle, icons at 3x ordinary size. Above it, in ivory negative space, huge confident black handwritten brush lettering 'See you on your Mac.' with small sans line 'Perry. Your AI assistant for Mac.' A row of gorgeous recognizable native Finder, Safari, Notes icons sits in a translucent ivory dock shelf. Between Finder and Safari an empty rounded-square space has opened. Tiny black line Perry stands in that space, facing viewer, one hand resting on Finder icon like a new neighbor. A coral cursor hovers next to him. The empty slot has a fine coral outline; no app icon box around mascot. Below the dock centered a single crisp black pill 'Get Perry for Mac ↗'. Small line 'Ask. Learn. Do.' Bottom 100 pixels is actual restrained footer with perry handwritten wordmark left, 'Privacy   Terms   Contact' right and small 'Back to top ↑'. Crop giant dock slightly at left and right so it feels physical and expansive. Background retains faint pencil mountain horizon only at extreme edges. Art direction balances unusually huge familiar icons with tiny character occupying new home. This must feel like the final scene of the desktop journey, a strong quiet emotional invitation, not an install instruction. Do not invent compatibility, pricing, download count or testimonials.
